# github.com/google/gnostic-models v0.7.0: openapiv3 (messages, ToRawInfo, YAMLValue) and the
# yaml.Node helpers of compiler. openapiv3_tables.inc and openapiv3_fields.h are generated by
# mkopenapiv3.py from the upstream sources.
add_library(go_gnostic_models STATIC openapiv3.c)
target_include_directories(go_gnostic_models PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(go_gnostic_models PUBLIC go_yaml go_protodesc go_std)
